messages:
alex: Team — launching a Lighthouse POC with BeaconHealth next week. Can we confirm the perf plan + any enterprise blockers? They want sustained 250 qps (seq len 128), p99 < 250ms if possible. 

mira: Copy. 250 qps sustained is realistic if we do dedicated pool + priming. Need to know payload size and whether they expect streaming responses. Also: are they using embeddings or text-gen?

alex: Text-gen only, model: open-llm/giant-13b-quant. No streaming. Avg request ~ 60 tokens output, prompt ~ 80 tokens.

dan: Ok — for that model & lengths, we'll project token throughput ~ 12k tokens/s per GPU with quantized path; ~1.5k reqs/s if batched aggressively, but latency tradeoffs. For p99 <250ms at 250 qps we should avoid large batch windows. Recommend continuous batching with max batch size 8 and latency cap 50ms.

sam: Actionable plan: 1) run smoke (10 min) at 50 qps to baseline 2) burn-in 30m ramp to 250 qps with 5m step increases 3) sustain 1h at 250 qps 4) spike tests: 500 qps for 5m 5) collect p50/p95/p99, cpu/gpu util, KV cache hit rate, network egress. 

mira: I'll draft a runbook. Key knobs: --max-batch=8, --batch-wait-ms=10, --kv-cache-enabled=true. Warmup: 5000 priming tokens (~100 requests) to populate caches before measuring. Also run with and without quantized variant to compare cost/latency.

loadbot: deploy-bench: started job lighthouse-bench-1719991230 at 1719991250. status: provisioning nodes.

alex: Excellent. One enterprise note from BeaconHealth: they need HSM-backed KMS for keys and an SOC2 supplement. Olivia, any blockers on security questionnaire or HSM latency impact?

olivia: Security side: we can provide DPA + SOC2 report. HSM — if they require remote HSM (cloud KMS) there will be an extra ~5-12ms per request for key unwrap on session start; not per-token. If they want per-request envelope encryption with HSM calls on each request that's an operational no-go for latency. Recommend envelope keys cached in the instance (KMS unwrap once per session). We should capture their requirement: KMS for model weights? or request payloads?

alex: They asked for payload encryption at rest and in transit; HSM for signing of audit logs only. So we probably do KMS unwrap at session start as Olivia suggested.

dan: On the perf side, HSM unwrap at session start is negligible. But if they want per-request crypto ops, that will blow p99. Confirmed.

sam: Pricing question from procurement: what's estimated token cost for 1 month at 250 qps sustained, 8hr/day? Quick calc: 250 reqs/s * 3600s * 8h = 7,200,000 requests/day. Avg tokens per request (input+output) ~ 220 => 1.584B tokens/day. Monthly ~ 1.584B * 22 working days = ~34.8B tokens. We'll need to propose reserved capacity pricing or a committed monthly.

alex: Good point. Can finance give a back-of-envelope per-token cost under Dedicated reserved vs Hosted burst?

sam: Ballpark: Dedicated reserved w/ quantized model ~ $0.0000025 per token; hosted maybe 2-3x. Will refine after we run bench.

mira: Practical bench notes: use wrk-based runner + our request shim so headers/auth mirror prod. Command snippet: 

```bash
./bench-runner --target http://redwood-dedicated.local/generate \  --concurrency 250 \  --seq-len 208 \  --max-batch 8 \  --ramp 5m \  --duration 1h \  --primer-requests 1000
```

mira: We'll export metrics to prometheus; please make sure CloudWatch export has GPU util, pcie rx/tx, and kube pod restarts.

olivia: Also add an attestations step: we need a short scan of container images and a signed SBOM attached to the bench artifacts for the prospect. They asked for supply-chain notes.

alex: Noted. Also Beacon wants result graphs with error budget impact and a fallback plan — they want if latency > p99 400ms trigger fallback to smaller model (giant-7b-quant). Can we simulate an autoscale fallback in the run?

dan: Yes — we can run a second pass where we intentionally constrain capacity (limit gpu count) to force fallback. We'll record failover latency and cold-start times. Expect cold-start of pinned variant ~ 12-20s unless we prewarm. Prewarm strategy: keep standby model loaded or maintain a small warm pool.

mira: Blocker: tenant needs to sign enterprise network access form to allow us to run bench from their VPC. Otherwise we'll use dedicated test region — but it won't reflect their network egress. Alex, can you follow up with Beacon infra?

alex: I'll ping infra + Beacon now. @beacon-contact — can you fill the network access form we sent? We need CIDR allowlist for bench nodes.

loadbot: bench job lighthouse-bench-1719991230: nodes provisioned.

sam: Next steps: Mira to post runbook, Dan to prepare fallback tests, Olivia to confirm SBOM + KMS wording, Alex to chase network access, Sam to draft preliminary pricing note. ETA: bench run Wed 09:00 PT. 

mira: I'll post runbook in #eng-runtime later today with exact prometheus dashboards. Will include the bench artifact link and CSV of p50/p95/p99. 

alex: Thanks team :thumbsup: — will update Beacon and sync on Wed morning after the smoke.

olivia: I'll attach SOC2 snippet + SBOM checklist to the thread once ready.

loadbot: bench artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/lighthouse/1719991230/results.tar.gz

alex: Perfect. Closing loop here — will follow up after smoke and attach prospect feedback.
